parent_objective: audit M2382 application-plan artifacts before any candidate config generation or validation route
blocked_by: M2382 materializes application-plan artifacts but does not audit whether they are sufficient for a bounded next route
candidate config generation, patch application, repair execution, and reset validation remain blocked until application-plan artifacts are audited
supersedes: direct candidate config generation from application-plan artifacts without audit
direct config patch application or reset validation from application-plan artifacts

public_gates: M2383 must audit M2382 application-plan summary, candidate counts, patch references, guardrail scope, and claim boundary without applying patches
M2383 must identify the next bounded route or stop the branch

M2383 must keep active-config overwrite, config application, candidate config generation, repair execution, reset/rollout, ranking, paper finite-window-vs-GRU, current-sim verdict, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not write candidate config files
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits application-plan artifacts before any candidate config generation or validation route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no active config overwrite, config application, candidate config generation, repair execution, rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if M2382 artifacts are incomplete or internally inconsistent
stop if patch references are missing
stop if candidate config files were written or patches applied
stop if audit would route directly to training or ranking without bounded candidate config generation design
fallback_plan: route to application-plan schema repair if artifacts are inconsistent
route to bounded next design if artifacts are accepted
route to branch synthesis if application-plan artifacts are insufficient to choose a route

allowed_updates: M2383 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2382 artifacts are accepted or rejected
candidate and patch reference counts are summarized
a bounded next route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2383 audits application-plan artifacts and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2383; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Application-plan artifacts remain engineering design artifacts until candidate config generation and measured validation.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits application-plan artifacts but does not yet test capability
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit bounded next design but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2383 cannot audit or route from application-plan artifacts
M2383 proposes direct active config overwrite, ranking, or paper conclusion
the repair-plan materialization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: Auditing M2382 application-plan artifacts can decide the next bounded route without applying patches, generating candidate config files, executing repair, ranking, training, or paper-level claims.
success_criteria: M2382 candidate counts, patch references, guardrail scope, and claim boundary are audited

active config overwrite, patch application, candidate config generation, repair execution, ranking, winner selection, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, current-sim verdict, and level3 self-ID claims remain blocked
a bounded non-ranking follow-up route is selected or branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2383 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2383 applies config patches or overwrites active config
M2383 executes repair levers or trains
M2383 ranks support policies or controller families
M2383 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim verdict or level3 self-ID claims
M2383 claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success
M2383 cannot decide next route from complete application-plan artifacts

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual audit of M2382 application-plan artifacts

decision_rule: M2383 passes if it audits M2382 application-plan artifacts and selects a bounded non-ranking follow-up route or stops the branch.
